subject.title: Runtime Self Context: give agents runtime, scale, offload, and cost awareness

question: Should OpenClaw accept the v1 runtime self-context contract from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90101 as a core config/tool surface, narrow it, or defer the design?
rationale: The remaining work defines new config, prompt exposure, model-facing tool, and offload/cost contracts; code inspection can show the gap, but cannot choose the permanent product/API boundary.

options.title: Review And Narrow V1
options.body: Keep this issue open and ask maintainers to approve or narrow the `runtimeContext` config, exposure modes, and `runtime` tool shape before any first slice merges.

options.title: Accept The Core Contract
options.body: Approve the linked PR's v1 surface as the core anchor and track provider refresh, action execution, and precise estimates as follow-ups.

options.title: Defer The Direction
options.body: Pause or close the implementation PR until runtime placement, provider hooks, and offload/cost semantics are designed together.

recommendation.title: Review And Narrow V1
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and ask maintainers to approve or narrow the `runtimeContext` config, exposure modes, and `runtime` tool shape before any first slice merges.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the adjacent environment-discovery and runtime-context prompt fixes, making them the best history-backed routing candidate in this review set.
